note: Mason County TX does not publish zoning districts as a queryable service. Texas counties generally lack county zoning authority. The only zoning for the City of Mason is a PDF zoning map (DocumentCenter/View/99) and ordinance PDFs, with no ArcGIS REST or GeoJSON layer. Searches of ArcGIS Online and Hub for Mason County zoning returned nothing. Parcel data is at masoncad.org and gismaps.org but carries no zoning layer.
